item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find solid 2023 evidence that Putin introduced new operational safeguards of the kind this lens asks for, such as tighter launch-authority procedures, stronger physical custody measures beyond Russian retention of control, improved stockpile-security standards, or explicit accident-prevention reforms. The available evidence is mostly policy language plus a custody claim, offset by a more risk-prone forward deployment into Belarus.","evidence":[{"title":"Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 31.03.2023 г. № 229","publisher":"Kremlin","date":"31 Mar 2023","url":"https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/49090/print","summary":"Russia’s updated foreign-policy concept says it will strengthen technical and physical nuclear safety, prevent nuclear terrorism, improve predictability, prevent unintentional armed incidents, and support arms control. This is the clearest 2023 pro-1B.3 evidence, but it is declaratory policy rather than proof of operational reform.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1"]},{"title":"Russia signs deal to deploy tactical nuclear weapons in Belarus, says they stay under its control","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"25 May 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/russia-signs-deal-to-deploy-tactical-nuclear-weapons-in-belarus-says-they-stay-under-its-control/1593879/","summary":"Moscow said it would retain control over the weapons and any decisions on their use, which is relevant positive evidence for custody and command discipline. The same report also says Belarusian servicemen received training and that a special storage facility was being established, which complicates the safety picture.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1"]},{"title":"Belarus units complete training on Russian tactical nuclear missile systems","publisher":"Reuters via WSAU / syndicated Reuters report","date":"22 Apr 2023","url":"https://wsau.com/2023/04/22/belarus-units-complete-training-on-russian-tactical-nuclear-missile-systems/","summary":"Belarusian units returned from Russia after training on how to use the Iskander system to launch nuclear weapons, including maintenance and use of tactical nuclear warheads. That is not evidence of tighter safety controls; it suggests wider handling and a larger operational surface for error or misuse.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1"]},{"title":"Russia moves ahead with deployment of tactical nuclear weapons in Belarus","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"25 May 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-belarus-sign-document-on-tactical-nuclear-weapon-deployment-in-belarus-3090472","summary":"Russia moved ahead with the first deployment of part of its nuclear arsenal outside Russia since 1991, placing tactical nuclear weapons in Belarus and building a storage arrangement there. That is stronger evidence of expanded nuclear exposure and command complexity than of improved accident-prevention safeguards.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1","1B.2"]}]}
